body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

## Benchmark

<details open>

<summary>PC specifications</summary>

- **CPU:** AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090
- **RAM:** 64 GB (2×32 GB DDR5-6000 CL30)
- **SSD:** Solidigm P44 Pro 2 TB
- **OS:** Linux (Fedora 44)
</details>

Using the testing project from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/100279, and release optimized export template builds with LTO.

## 3840×2160 fullscreen

Renderer | `master` | This PR
-|-|-
Forward+ | 3132 FPS (0.31 mspf) | 3236 FPS (0.30 mspf)
Mobile | 5796 FPS (0.17 mspf) | 6413 FPS (0.15 mspf)
Compatibility | 6464 FPS (0.15 mspf) | 7546 FPS (0.13 mspf)

## 1152×648 window on llvmpipe

Can't test anymore, not sure if this is a system issue:

```
ERROR: Unhandled XServer error: BadDrawable (invalid Pixmap or Window parameter)
   Major opcode of failed request: 149
   Serial number of failed request: 4
   Current serial number in output stream: 311
   at: default_window_error_handler (platform/linuxbsd/x11/display_server_x11.cpp:1335)
```

On other projects like [Material Testers](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/3d/material_testers), [godot-reflecton](https://github.com/Calinou/godot-reflection) or the TPS demo, I can't spot a performance difference in 3840×2160.

I can test on mobile or integrated graphics if you'd like.
